Subject: Partner onboarding: Integrator enablement and sandbox access

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the quick connect last week — following up from our call. BlueMap is onboarding a small systems integrator arm (8 engineers, 2 delivery leads) that will be responsible for integrating Redwood into three customer pilots over the next quarter. We want a structured enablement path so the SI can certify internally and then deliver repeatable implementations.

Key asks:
- Short-term: sandbox access + reference playbook for basic connector patterns (2–4 weeks)
- Mid-term: Train-the-Trainer (T3) so BlueMap trainers can run customer workshops
- Admin: expected SOW and any pricing for a 2-day onsite T3 session

Can you share a recommended onboarding sequence and any materials you typically provide for partners? Also, we’ll need a stub SOW for procurement.

Thanks,
Samir

Subject: Re: Partner onboarding: Integrator enablement and sandbox access — proposed T3 plan

Samir —

Appreciate the note. Pasted below is a concise proposal for BlueMap’s SI enablement pathway. I’ve attached a short playbook and a draft T3 schedule for your review. We can iterate on scope once procurement shares constraints.

Executive summary (recommended 4-week ramp):
1) Intake & scoping (days 0–3): identify pilot use cases, access needs, credentials, and data security boundaries.
2) Integrator Sandbox (days 4–14): dedicated sandbox with sample datasets, three guided labs (auth/connect/observability), and a troubleshooting office hour.
3) Train-the-Trainer (days 15–21): 2-day intensive T3 workshop + 1 day shadow delivery; train BlueMap trainers on prompt patterns, routing policies, and rollout best practices.
4) Certification & Handoff (days 22–28): lab-based pass/fail cert, access handoff, and SOW for follow-on paid enablement.

Deliverables we’ll provide:
- Integrator sandbox environment (ephemeral + option for persistent dev pool)
- Step-by-step playbook (attached: integrator_sandbox_playbook_v1.pdf)
- T3 schedule (attached: t3-schedule.xlsx)
- Example SOW & pricing bands (we’ll send a draft SOW once you confirm region and expected seat count)

Open questions for BlueMap:
- Are the 8 engineers spread across 2 offices or co-located? (impacts on on-site logistics)
- Do you need an on-prem/private deployment demo or is hosted API enough for pilots?

Next steps:
- If the outline looks good, I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Laura (enablement) and Ben (partner ops) to lock dates and draft the SOW.

Regards,
Avery Johnson
Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com

Hi Samir / team —

Thanks for the details, Samir. Quick operational follow-up — we recommend the following concrete schedule options for the T3 and initial sandbox run:

Option A (fast):
- Week 1: Intake + sandbox provisioning (remote)
- Week 2: Guided labs + office hour (remote)
- Week 3: Onsite 2-day T3 (San Francisco) + 1 day shadow (onsite or remote)

Option B (staggered):
- Week 1–2: Remote sandbox + labs
- Week 3–4: Remote T3 in two half-day sessions + extended shadowing

Pricing & SOW notes (high level):
- Remote T3 (per cohort, up to 10 engineers): $12k (includes trainer time, lab prep, access)
- Onsite T3 (2-day + 1 trainer): $18k + travel expenses (est. $1.5–$3k depending on location)
- Sandbox provisioning (ephemeral): included for pilots; persistent dev pool is billed monthly (we’ll list options in SOW)

Certification criteria (quick):
- Complete 3 lab tasks with reproducible runs
- Deliver a short runbook (1–2 pages) for each pilot use case
- Trainer sign-off after shadow delivery

I’ve attached a lightweight workshop outline (integrator_workshop_outline.pdf) and a draft partner scope (partner_scope_poc.docx) you can use for procurement. If BlueMap confirms Option A and SF onsite, Ben can help lock venues and dates.

Laura Bennett
